question: Which employees hired in 2023 handled more than 130 orders?
sql: SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN orders o ON o.employee_id = e.id WHERE strftime('%Y', e.hire_date) = '2023' GROUP BY e.id HAVING COUNT(*) > 130

question: Which customer region generated the most completed revenue in 2024?
sql: SELECT c.region FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2024' GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY SUM(o.total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What percentage of customers in North America are on the enterprise tier?
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN tier = 'enterprise' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) FROM customers WHERE region = 'North America'

question: How many orders were handled by each employee role?
sql: SELECT e.role, COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN employees e ON e.id = o.employee_id GROUP BY e.role

question: On average, how many line items does an order have?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(n), 2) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id)

question: How many different customers have bought CRM Pro?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.name = 'CRM Pro'
